blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On the 35th day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial Wednesday, representatives of multiple banks testified on the financial records of Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, as the prosecution continued presenting evidence on alleged unexplained wealth. Witnesses from Asia United Bank, Philippine Savings Bank, Metrobank, Security Bank, BPI, PNB, and BDO were called, covering at least 30 bank accounts across eight banks whose combined ending balances the prosecution claims exceeded P190 million not declared in Duterte’s SALN.
